validator: independent validator subagent (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-12; validator code in validation/scripts/, not the producer's
rows_commit: 9ce79930e74398c8bc969c22caaec5964ef76d10 (rows' commit field; study files identical to the protocol commit 25a25407818e520942ee89ba7836b3ff936c2e1d)

pristine_source_build.toolchain: rustc 1.97.0 / cargo 1.97.0; rand 0.8.8 (rand_chacha 0.3.1, rand_core 0.6.4), serde_json 1.0.151 (arbitrary_precision, raw_value), release profile; Python 3 + numpy

instrumented_build.patch: validation/scripts/patch_instr.py (adds no counted operation; HashMap-call, canonicalisation, step-index-hash and DP-test counts, retention-log samples and target dumps to stderr)

replay.sampling: sha256(nonce:row) order; pristine: first 4 rows per (arm, bits) = 60 (12 per arm, 4 at 32 bits); producer binary: first 1 per (arm, bits) = 15; dump: one configuration per (bits, T) cell chosen by sha256(nonce:cfg), all 20 runs
replay.fields_compared: every field the binary prints except ms: arm, n, p, targets, seed, param, ok, I, M, S, H, L, every phase snapshot, every arm extra
replay.instances: frozen git-archive copy of bb3d2bc40e; every file hashes to MANIFEST.json and regenerates byte-identically from the stated gen_instances.py command

scalar_verification.method: instrumented build dumps (planted x_t, recovered log, Q_t) per target; validator Python (validation/scripts/ecv.py: Jacobian double-and-add, Fermat inversion; nothing shared with the harness) checks Q_t on the curve, 0 <= log < n, log == x_t mod n, [log]G == Q_t; planted lists identical across the 20 runs of each configuration

retention_log_check.method: claimed logs of points the retention arms insert, sampled (x % 211 == 0, first 300 per run) from every run of the full replay, checked by [log]G (validation/scripts/verify_samples.py)
